preconditions: Explicit independent review selecting at least three unique controls
Each selected control is direct observed subsurface contact evidence with authorized absolute Z and an artifact SHA-256
decisionLogic: Never correlate controls automatically by lithology label, similar depth, or spatial proximity.
Bind the review to the complete candidate registry using canonical SHA-256.
Require distinct independentSupportId values and pass the shared surface evidence audit.
exclusions: No repeated samples from one support counted as independent
validationMethod: Positive, draft, tamper, unknown ID, duplicate ID, malformed hash and fake-independence tests
reopenCondition: Authenticated reviewer signatures or probabilistic correlation ensembles are introduced
